fouls.name: Double Contact
fouls.description: A player hits the ball twice in succession, or the ball contacts various parts of their body in succession.
fouls.penalty: Loss of rally and point awarded to opponent.

fouls.name: Lift / Catch / Carry
fouls.description: The ball is caught or thrown rather than rebounding cleanly from the hit.
fouls.penalty: Loss of rally and point awarded to opponent.

fouls.name: Net Touch
fouls.description: A player contacts the top band of the net or interferes with play while playing the ball.

fouls.name: Rotation Fault
fouls.description: Players are not in their correct rotational order at the precise instant the server contacts the ball.
fouls.penalty: Loss of rally and point awarded to opponent; players must correct their positions.

fouls.name: Back-row Attack Fault
fouls.description: A back-row player completes an attack hit from in front of the 3m attack line with the ball entirely above the top of the net.

fouls.name: Four Hits
fouls.description: A team hits the ball four times before returning it over the net.
